name: Tangie
summary: **Tangie** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Crockett Family Farms]] in California, starting in the late 2000s. A cross of [[california-orange|California Orange]] and [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]], it was made to revive the 1990s strain Tangerine Dream. [[breeder:DNA Genetics]] later commercialized it worldwide in the early 2010s.

sources.title: Strain Spotlight: Tangie — Crockett Family Farms and the Citrus Revival in Modern Cannabis
